0022600210.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-5, 11th in the West, 5th in the Southwest and 3.5 games back, on a one-game losing streak, and 1-2 on the road) visit the Golden State Warriors (7-3, 4th in the West, 2nd in the Pacific and 1.5 games back, on a seven-game winning streak). Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery) and Will Richard (thumb), and Gui Santos is day-to-day with knee tendinitis and a game-time decision. In the 2025-26 season series the Pelicans lost 1-2, but they won the last meeting 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026, and the two teams have no games yet in 2026-27.
